include(FetchContent)

set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS "$ENV{CFLAGS}")
set(CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS "$ENV{CXXFLAGS}")
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY COMPILE_OPTIONS "")
set_property(DIRECTORY PROPERTY COMPILE_DEFINITIONS "")
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC OFF)
set(CMAKE_AUTOUIC OFF)
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC OFF)
set(CMAKE_POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
set(CMAKE_C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_DEFAULT_CMP0077 NEW)
set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.10)

set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(WHISPER_USE_SYSTEM_GGML OFF)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_TESTS OFF)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF)
set(WHISPER_BUILD_SERVER OFF)
set(GGML_BACKEND_DL OFF)
set(GGML_NATIVE OFF)
set(GGML_CPU ON)
set(GGML_OPENMP OFF)
set(GGML_CCACHE OFF)
if(CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR MATCHES "^(x86_64|AMD64)$")
    foreach(extension SSE42 AVX AVX2 BMI2 FMA F16C)
        set(GGML_${extension} ON)
    endforeach()
endif()

FetchContent_Declare(whisper_cpp
    URL https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/archive/refs/tags/v${KBOARD_WHISPER_VERSION}.tar.gz
    URL_HASH SHA256=${KBOARD_WHISPER_SHA256}
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP ON
    SOURCE_SUBDIR no-cmake-project
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(whisper_cpp)
add_subdirectory(${whisper_cpp_SOURCE_DIR} ${whisper_cpp_BINARY_DIR} EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL SYSTEM)
